In an interview with Joanna Stern, OpenAI president Greg Brockman discussed the company's recent adjustments to the ChatGPT desktop application and talked about development plans for a tabless interface. Watch the video below.

ChatGPT May Seamlessly Integrate Work Features

A few days ago, Joanna Stern released a trailer for an interview with OpenAI president Greg Brockman on her new YouTube channel, New Things.

Today, Stern released the full interview, covering topics including the new ChatGPT Voice, OpenAI's hardware development plans, the Apple lawsuit, and the recent Hugging Face security breach.

During the interview, Stern mentioned that OpenAI recently merged the ChatGPT and Codex desktop applications, and simultaneously launched a new agent mode called "Work" for ChatGPT.

The merged interface left users confused, especially those who simply wanted to continue using ChatGPT but had difficulty finding their chat history.

OpenAI subsequently updated the application, adding separate "Work" and "Chat" tabs at the top of the interface, and adding a dropdown menu in the left panel to switch between ChatGPT and Codex. Although the operation is no longer as difficult, the overall interface is still somewhat cumbersome.

When asked about this misstep, Brockman agreed with Stern, acknowledging that the new interface was "a bit confusing," while adding that this is a "gradual" move towards the future, and that the "Work" tab would eventually disappear, with its features being "seamlessly integrated into ChatGPT".

Brockman also said that despite the confusing rollout of the merged application, OpenAI still saw the expected results, with the number of Codex users multiplying from 5 million to 10 million in just a few days.

When pressed on whether the growth was purely due to "cramming" Codex into the ChatGPT application, Brockman admitted again, while also arguing that this was part of the intention:

The entire interview is quite excellent and worth watching. It also includes a very "Joanna Stern-style" attempt to incorporate ChatGPT Voice into the conversation, with results just as you might expect.
